notes: DRAFT. Opening chapter, one short line per screen. speaker: narrator, sensei, guardian. Screens 1-8 play on first entering the Tower; 9-11 on reaching the white-tier Guardian; 12-13 after the Guardian is defeated (it gives no light yet); 14-17 when the real promotion opens the Gate (framework: only the real belt opens the Gate). Screen 15 echoes John 1:5. Faith themes added at Jay's direct request (2026-10-12).
name: The Shattered Light

guardian.name: The Lamp Keeper
guardian.description: Once it kept the Tower's first lamp lit. The shadow made it forget, but it never stopped hoping.

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: Long ago, a great light shone at the top of the Tower.

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: It was a gift from God, and it kept the town warm and safe.

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: One night, the light broke into pieces.

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: Shadow slipped into the Tower, floor by floor.

screens.speaker: sensei
screens.text: Darkness never wins against the light. Not even a little.

screens.speaker: sensei
screens.text: Each piece of light is still up there, waiting for you.

screens.speaker: sensei
screens.text: Every belt you earn helps bring one home.

screens.speaker: sensei
screens.text: You do not have to be fearless. You only have to begin.

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: At the top of the white floors waits the first Guardian.

screens.speaker: guardian
screens.text: Who climbs my stairs? Turn back!

screens.speaker: sensei
screens.text: Remember your training. Watch, wait, then answer.

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: The Lamp Keeper bows its head. Something glows in its hands.

screens.speaker: guardian
screens.text: A spark... I had forgotten how warm it feels.

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: With your new belt, the Gate opens, and the first piece of light rises.

screens.speaker: sensei
screens.text: Even a small light shines in the dark.

screens.speaker: sensei
screens.text: Look. The town is a little brighter tonight.

screens.speaker: sensei
screens.text: What did you learn on your way up?

relics.name: Cracked Lamp Glass
relics.description: A curved piece of glass, still warm. It came from something very big and very bright.
relics.sensei: Something this warm was never meant to stay in the dark.

relics.name: Faded Map
relics.description: An old map of the Tower. Someone circled the very top floor.
relics.sensei: Someone else climbed before you. You are not alone on this path.

relics.name: Little Wick
relics.description: A tiny wick, still glowing. Even a small light can fill a dark room.
relics.sensei: A small light still matters. So do you.
